brief: Independently discover one practical current technology topic for Thai everyday computer users or junior developers. Verify important claims against official source page bodies. Avoid OneDrive, internal test announcements, unsupported trend claims and invented experience. Write one concise useful Thai text post. Record source URLs, retrieval dates, limits and a compact handoff. No publishing, scheduling or video generation.
editorialRules: Natural conversational Thai with familiar technical terms. No decorative emoji, exaggerated promises, engagement bait or fabricated numbers. Use an empty hashtag string. Give practical steps and their limitations; distinguish documented facts from interpretations. Follow the selected Page's saved prohibitions. Owner review is required before any separate approval or publication.
